description: Works out a bass note for the chord arriving as a polyphonic pitch and puts it out as a single note

params.text: Steps through the three ways of picking the note in turn; the lit lamp shows whether harmonic, lowest or random is in force
Sets the pitch class of the lowest note the module will put out, the twelve semitones counting up from C
Sets the octave of the lowest note the module will put out, 0 to 8, with 4 putting C at 0V

inputs.text: The chord, as a polyphonic 1V/octave pitch with one note per channel
Only the channels whose gate here is above 0V are counted as part of the chord; with nothing patched every channel of the cv input is used

outputs.text: The chosen bass note as a 1V/octave pitch, moved into whichever octave puts it at or above the lowest note set by the oct and note knobs

notes: the bass note is worked out afresh only when the incoming chord changes, so the output holds its last note while the input is unchanged.
the display above the knobs reads out the lowest note the oct and note knobs are set to.
menu: Minimum polyphony — sets how many sounding notes the chord must have before a new bass note is worked out, 1 to 16

inputs.1:
high above 0V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads every channel of the cv input counts.

outputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
